item.title: Billy Jean King Did Not Just Change Tennis, She Challenged Sexism
item.description: In 1973, a tennis match caught the world’s attention for reasons much bigger than sport. item.title: Manipuri Film ‘Boong’ Scripts History At 79th BAFTA Awards: What Is It About?
item.description: An Indian film made in 2024 has finally got its recognition at the 79th BAFTA awards on February 23, 2026. The film is produced by Ritesh Sidhwani, Alan McAlex and Farhan Akhtar. item.title: Under New Taliban Code, Beating Wife Is Legal As Long As No Bones Are Broken
item.description: The Taliban in Afghanistan has introduced a new 90-page penal code that "legalises" domestic violence against women, allowing husbands to physically abuse their wives and children as long as there are no "broken bones or open wounds".
